reserveReview.rationale: The August 31 USDGO Reserve Report discloses $99,693,768 STBXX, $674,279,453 JLTXX, $462,545,429 BUIDL and $12,431,912 cash, totaling $1,248,950,562. These dated balances normalize to the curated percentages, rounded to six decimals. The issuer's September 29 dashboard snapshot remains a newer issuer observation for the live adapter, but has no corresponding independent examination in the issuer's report index; this curated composition remains aligned to the August 31 examination.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Deloitte examination of the USDGO Reserve Report as of August 31, 2026; Schedule II balances normalized by $1,248,950,562 total reserve assets.
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The report discloses the two money market fund CUSIPs; their names are verified against the fund managers' product pages. Underlying fund portfolios and account-level custodians remain outside the report's disclosed scope.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The August report confirms segregated, unencumbered fiduciary trust accounts for token holders and Anchorage's self-custody of $462,545,429 BUIDL on Solana. It identifies 9yGxs2pSFFBZhJVrwRAgbKHaLQnuHa7BpmCRsHuzG968, but does not name the banks holding $12,431,912 cash or the money market funds' account-level custodians. Anchorage's provider share is not disclosed; no 100% custody allocation is assumed. A standing rehypothecation policy and report-time wallet balances remain unverified.
